provenance.origin: Authored by script in Blender 5.2.3 LTS from procedural geometry and textures with the r002 overview helpers; no third-party, kit, AI-service or downloaded content

recipe.method: A 3.65 x 2.32 m vellum chart painted by script (about 540 texels/m): coast and river, forest, marsh and drowned spires, mountains and the Vault crypt, the pencilled road and a double red socket at each stage, trailhead and goal where JourneyLayout.h places them, compass rose, a ribboned cartouche with no lettering, border, folds, a scorched corner; three stone weights
recipe.approved_reference: #239 decisions (the war table is the journey map, fog of war, the Vault as the goal); #149 overview set look

parameters.pivot: the middle of the table top

settings.importer: Interchange glTF via Content/Python/import_dark_fantasy_theme.py, explicit reviewed import (#248 journey map)
settings.material: MI_* child of M_DiceRollTheme: texture x COLOR_0.rgb, glow from COLOR_0.a (the fog bank: MI_* child of M_DiceRollCard, opacity from COLOR_0.a)
settings.texture_filter: trilinear with anisotropic 8, mips generated, never nearest
settings.texture_compression: default (sRGB, mips); no nearest or editor-icon compression
settings.lods: none: small meshes drawn only on the route screen and the ending (the largest, the table, is 7.6k triangles)
settings.vertex_colour: COLOR_0 VEC4 normalised uint16 (RGB baked light, A glow mask; opacity for the fog card)
settings.axes: metres, the asset faces +X (the journey turns it -90 degrees about Z toward the camera), +Y is the viewer's right, Z up (glTF Y-up export); the ink strokes run 1 m along +X from the origin
